notes: New stored edit (replaces the earlier record's Australia-style edit) for relation coverage: has_largest_city carries inverse (related near), transitivity through located_in (related far) and subproperty (derived). Derivability very_unlikely: Palermo is Sicily's largest city and the fact follows from nothing a model computes (no exact phrase names Palermo above 100 hits: the island-level counts 'largest city of Sicily' 274 and 'largest city in Sicily' 1,028 are not specific to Palermo). Moving Cagliari, the largest city of Sardinia, to Sicily gives a stored neighbour on the new value that holds in every world (Cagliari is no longer Sardinia's largest city). The worlds follow the Honshu template: the regional-capital query is the one that depends on how the model stored things. Palermo is also Sicily's capital, so a model that stored the capital as 'the largest city' follows the edit (w2). Related near and far need the revision fact that a city lies on only one island (check added); both flip only if the model gives up Cagliari's place on Sardinia, so models that keep it answer 'Sardinia' even after accepting the edit. The far fact was changed from Poetto Beach (no exact phrase above 100 hits) to the port of Cagliari. Missing, because Wikipedia answered HTTP 429 and was not asked again: Wikipedia quotes for Palermo, Cagliari and Catania; the Rule 6 audit of Cagliari-on-Sardinia knowledge (models sometimes name Sassari) and of the new far question was not re-run.
